title: grain/exclude@v1: removes names from the contribution of the folder holding it, and from nothing else. Excluding an include object's name disables that include. There is no re-include (docs/task-repos.md §3.3)

names.description: Exact names, as references (relative, alias or URL form), canonicalised before matching. No @ref and no #anchor

patterns.description: Names by glob over the canonical path, after the repo part is canonicalised: * matches within one path segment, ** across segments. The repo part is never a glob
